theorem.same_carrier_two_measures: mu_r and nu_r are measures on the same finite canonical target turn set E_r but have different atom weights in general

proof: The AM closed fibers cover the full source circle, their interiors are pairwise disjoint and neighboring overlaps are boundary rays of source arc measure zero; finite additivity therefore gives the exact weighted sum. Target counting is the AK/AL minimal turn period by definition of nu_r.

source_constant_typing.definition: Circ_perp(r)=2*kappa_perp*r in the accepted orthogonal source realization

semantic_boundary: The global mean is a conversion statistic between two measures; it is not a local isometry factor.
